$comment: Null means invalid, discontinuous or partial current source. Identity equality across child projections is additionally enforced by the assembler and invariant tests. Legacy projections retain their own field names; generation there equals binding.source_generation. v4 current P/T values are exact signed int32 object literals admitted only by the producer from visible Battlefield Cards/Tokens; the portable consumer cannot reauthenticate raw object type. Null is unknown, never inferred zero or static catalog fallback. Sources/durations remain unknown. v5 adds an opt-in all-or-unknown finite literal mana request profile, after the existing visibility gate. No response or successor is used. Passing local proposal checks never establishes complete legality.

readOnlyValue.$comment: Apply read-only and no-new-completeness-proof invariants recursively, including extensible legacy child projections. This constrains claims without interpreting opaque parameter structures.

phase1Completeness.$comment: Phase 1 supplies no new completeness proof.

publicStack.$comment: Array position preserves only literal GRE membership order. Runtime also checks exact positions, unique visible Stack references and complete membership; no top or resolution claim.
